## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior and any related issue.

## Validation

List the exact focused checks you ran and their results. Explain unavailable checks.

## Review

- [ ] The change is focused, with a regression check where useful.
- [ ] No credentials, private research, database copies or operational reports are included.
- [ ] Membership, researcher isolation and paper-ledger ownership are preserved.
- [ ] New dependencies and copied assets have appropriate license notices.
- [ ] Workflow changes keep contributor code away from production credentials and infrastructure.
